authority_note: Preserve user-stated reward amounts; every new timing, gate, scene, benefit and repeat rule is marked R_. Legacy saves retain their existing ruleset.

decision_ids.R_CAREER_001: Use zero REP for veterans community service until the missing live value is recovered; one Career is established.
decision_ids.R_CAREER_002: Award at completion, cap one rewarded family per completion lap across all paths; one active task per family.
decision_ids.R_CAREER_003: Three rewarded mentoring visits per path per game, with fresh relevant experience after the first.
decision_ids.R_CAREER_004: Graduation available after three completed laps, once per game; fictional milestone.
decision_ids.R_CAREER_005: Sports referral five percent capped at 2500; defined whitelist and one unused benefit.
decision_ids.R_CAREER_006: Thirteen explicit path scenes and role variants.
decision_ids.R_CAREER_007: Internship next-own-turn follow-up, one extension, one repair and one workload unit.
decision_ids.R_CAREER_008: Equal eligible-family weights for initial digital playtest; frozen offer on refresh.
decision_ids.R_CAREER_009: Specific path and campaign-planning competency govern Prepared launch; no universal mentor multiplier.

repeats.fresh_experience: A new completed, non-reversed relevant activity since the previous rewarded visit; changing industry labels or repurchasing the same item is not new experience.

internship.final_close: Resolve already-due action before financial freeze; unfinished has no reward. Technical failure is retry, never an authored player choice.

referral.application_order: After mandatory confirmed coverage, before elected compatible emergency support; consume only if positive discount and successful transaction.

ownership_gate: No mandatory career bundle or luxury purchase; financial and authored house-stage rules only.
